import json, collections
for name in ('base-debug','base-batch'):
    p = f'Resources/features/f-428/runs/P12.7/{name}.jsonl'
    aw = []
    with open(p) as f:
        for line in f:
            r = json.loads(line)
            if r['auto'] and not r['correct']:
                aw.append(r)
    print(name, 'autoWrong:', len(aw))
    print('  path:', collections.Counter(a['path'] for r in aw for a in r['atoms']))
    print('  multi-atom:', sum(1 for r in aw if len(r['atoms'])>1))
    print('  no actualDataTypes[0]:', sum(1 for r in aw if not r['actualDataTypes']))
    print('  no expectedDataTypes[0]:', sum(1 for r in aw if not r['expectedDataTypes']))
    print('  no actualDescriptions[0]:', sum(1 for r in aw if not r['actualDescriptions']))
    print('  no expectedDescriptions[0]:', sum(1 for r in aw if not r['expectedDescriptions']))
    print('  sets:', collections.Counter(r['set'] for r in aw))
    print('  reused+path:', collections.Counter((a['reused'], a['path']) for r in aw for a in r['atoms']))
EOF","i":"Checking auto-wrong line field coverage"}
